d: On November 5, India fires the Pralay missile from its testing range from its Eastern Coast in the State of Odisha. India's Defence Research and Development Organisation or DRDO carried out the successful missile test. India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh hailed the test and announced that the missile met all its test parameters. The Pralay missile test comes just days after Pakistan test-fired the Fattah-II Extended Range (ER).
